# Fairgate Partners

> Fairgate Partners LLC is a pay-per-call company in Los Angeles that sends live inbound phone calls from homeowners to roofing and home-service companies. Buyers pay only for billable calls.

## What we do
- Route live phone calls from homeowners who need roofing, water damage, plumbing or HVAC work to contractors in their area.
- Buyers set their service area, hours and a daily call cap.
- A call is billable when it connects and lasts past an agreed minimum, usually 90 seconds.
- Calls are not exclusive; they connect to whichever buyer answers first.
- Buyers prepay in small blocks; disputes are accepted within 7 days and reviewed against the call recording.
- Fairgate Partners does not guarantee booked jobs.
- Calls come from homeowners who chose to call; no robocalls or cold transfers.
